Surrender of ₹14,057.88
lakh was attributed to non
receipt of amount from
the Government of India
and receipt of additional
outlays in Grants-in-aid-
Non-Salary. Final excess
of ₹4.43 lakh is
overstated by ₹4.45 lakh
due to clearance of OB
suspense related to
previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹0.02 lakh.
Reasons for actual saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).

Reduction in provision by
re-appropriation of
₹788.00 lakh was
attributed to need of
additional amounts for
Wages/Honorarium.
Surrender of ₹8,571.19
lakh was attributed to non
receipt of Grants-in-aid
in central share from the
Government of India &
need of additional outlay.
Final excess of ₹3.40
lakh is overstated by
₹3.42 lakh due to
clearance of OB suspense
related to previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹0.02 lakh.
Reasons for actual saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
